item.title: Microsoft 365 Subscriptions Push Users to Free Office
item.description: Microsoft’s shift to subscription‑only Office frustrates users with AI‑driven pricing hikes, but free suites like OnlyOffice, LibreOffice and WPS offer comparable tools.
